subject: order-payment-state
detail: A records payment as a boolean 'paid' flag; C records it as status pending/paid/cancelled/refunded. Two sources of truth can disagree (paid=True while status=cancelled).
solutions: Make Order.status the only payment state and drop A's paid flag
recommended: Order.status is the single source of truth; 'paid' is derived (status == paid)

subject: cancel-paid-order
detail: C cancels a paid order without refunding it (orders.py:3), so money A charged is kept for a cancelled order; the user requires a cancelled paid order to be refunded exactly once.
solutions: Cancel of a paid order refunds through the gateway and ends in status refunded

subject: charge-retry-idempotency
detail: A's idempotency key falls back to str(id(order)) and gateway timeouts are not handled: after a timeout that charged, the order stays unpaid and a retry with another key charges twice.
solutions: Require the client key, remember the first key per order and reuse it for every retry
recommended: Client key required; first attempted key per order is recorded before the gateway call and reused on every retry; a key used for another order is refused; already-paid orders are never charged

subject: webhook-redelivery
detail: A applies every webhook delivery again and ignores the type; a duplicate delivery, or a webhook plus the synchronous pay() result, would be applied (and ledgered) twice.
solutions: De-duplicate by event id and make transitions state-checked
Ignore webhooks and rely on pay() only
recommended: Record processed event ids atomically with the change; charge.succeeded only moves pending->paid, charge.refunded only paid->refunded; the ledger is appended only on a real transition

subject: refund-not-idempotent
detail: gateway.refund(charge_id) has no idempotency key (gateway.py:23-25): every call creates a new refund, so a retried cancel or a cancel racing a refund webhook could refund twice.
solutions: Record a refund-requested marker before calling the gateway and never call refund again once it exists
recommended: Write a refund marker first; with a marker present, a retry completes the order as refunded without calling the gateway

subject: partial-writes
detail: No source persists anything; the user requires that a failed store write (StoreError) leaves the order unchanged, and the gateway call cannot be inside the write.
solutions: One atomic write per state change, checked before any mutation; intent markers written before gateway calls
recommended: Every state change is one atomic store write (all or nothing); payment and refund intents are written before the gateway call so a retry after a failed write is safe

subject: amount-units
detail: A uses order['amount'], B subscription['price'], the task uses amount_cents.

subject: renewal-duplication
detail: B creates a new order on every renew() call; renewing one period twice would bill the month twice.
recommended: renew(subscription, period) returns the existing order for the same subscription id and period
